intro: Diamonds made Botswana one of Africa's richest countries per person.

chapters.title: Diamonds
text: Botswana is one of the world's top diamond producers by value, with mines run with De Beers. Falling diamond demand has hurt the economy recently.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: High-value safari tourism in the Okavango is the second-biggest earner.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Botswana makes and sells to the world.
